text:
Priya: starting this thread to capture short customer win/loss blurbs + top asks from today's all-hands Q&A. please add 1-2 lines, paste links to tickets/notes if you have them.

Marcus: Won — fintech sandbox chose Dedicated for predictable throughput. reason: latency SLA + dedicated pool. follow-up: RED-4821 (sales notes). :tada:

Elena: Loss — large retail POC dropped us during eval. reason: hallucination on product descriptions, they needed better quality guarantees. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-733.

Gabe: Lost — model latency at long context killed the demo. we queued them to a competitor with shorter seqs. action: profiling task created (ENG-1298).

Ava: Win — mid-market analytics app adopted hosted API for embeddings because of lower integration work. ask was: "better batch-embedding SDK".

Marcus: Loss pattern — pricing confusions at procurement (per-token vs reserved). customers asked for clearer TCO examples and a migration worksheet.

Priya: can folks paste a one-line 'why we won/lost' + top ask? e.g. "Won: dedicated SLA. Ask: better on-prem docs." keeps it short.

Elena: example: "Lost: model quality mismatch for product copy. Ask: Q-rate metric and stable eval reports."

Gabe: example: "Lost: end-to-end latency at 4k tokens. Ask: transparent perf profiles by seq length + quantization option list."

Ava: I'm building a short tracker. please use this tiny template (paste under your message):

```
- customer: <org name>
- vertical: <industry>
- outcome: won | lost | still evaluating
- why: 1-line reason
- top_ask: 1-line customer request
- followup_owner: @name (quick link to doc/ticket)
```

Marcus: adding one now:
- customer: Kestrel Finance
- vertical: fintech
- outcome: won
- why: predictable throughput + commit pricing
- top_ask: example TCO for 6/12/24 month commits
- followup_owner: @Marcus (RED-4821)

Elena: adding one now:
- customer: BrightShelf
- vertical: retail
- outcome: lost
- why: hallucination & quality regressions vs baseline
- top_ask: stable eval reports and rollback guidelines
- followup_owner: @Elena (CS-733)

Gabe: quick engineering note: we need a reproducible perf gist for the 4k case. putting initial numbers here: https://gist.github.com/redwood/perf-4k (WIP).

ops-bot: Reminder — please add a card to the "sales-feedback" board. Due in 3 days.

Priya: thanks all — @Sam, any guidance on prioritization for roadmap asks mentioned here (perf profiles, eval reports, on-prem docs, TCO worksheet)?

Sam: Appreciate the signal. short plan: 1) put eval reports and perf profiles into the "must" bucket for next sprint, 2) on-prem docs + migration worksheet as "near-term" (next two releases), 3) TCO worksheet — product marketing will draft a template this week.

Ava: I'll own synthesize and post a 1-pager in #product by EOD Friday. will include top 3 wins, top 3 losses, and owners.

Marcus: will ping reps to add any missing deals.

Elena: tagging CS to flag any follow-ups that need a customer success playbook update.

Gabe: engineering will surface perf test results in a PR to the docs repo when ready.

Priya: perfect — thanks everyone. keep replies short and just paste the template entries so I can collate. :white_check_mark:
